description: This file defines the Expression class, which is part of the Wizard subcomponent of the ConditionalFormatting feature in PhpSpreadsheet. It manages conditional formatting rules based on formulas, allowing creation, editing, and conversion of such rules.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: Represents a conditional formatting expression rule in the PhpSpreadsheet library, allowing creation and manipulation of formula-based rules.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Sets the formula expression for the conditional formatting rule, validating the operand.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Generates a Conditional object based on the current expression and style settings.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates an Expression wizard object from an existing Conditional object, with optional cell range.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls, specifically to enforce that only 'formula' methods are valid.
